proposition_text: The occupier of a holding may apply to the Agency for a derogation where 80% or more of the agricultural area of the holding is sown with grass.
subject: occupier of a holding
rule: may apply to the Agency for a derogation
object: derogation from nitrogen limit in livestock manure
conditions: 80% or more of the agricultural area of the holding is sown with grass
evidence_text: The occupier of a holding may apply to the Agency for a derogation in a case where 80% or more of the agricultural area of the holding is sown with grass.
reason: Clear eligibility criterion for derogation application.

proposition_text: A derogation means a derogation granted under this Part from the limit on the total amount of nitrogen in livestock manure that can be applied to land each year in accordance with paragraph 2(b) of Annex III to Council Directive 91/676/EEC.
subject: derogation
object: derogation from nitrogen limit in livestock manure under paragraph 2(b) of Annex III to Council Directive 91/676/EEC
evidence_text: "Derogation" means a derogation granted under this Part from the limit on the total amount of nitrogen in livestock manure that can be applied to land each year in accordance with paragraph 2(b) of Annex III to Council Directive 91/676/EEC.

proposition_text: The reference to agricultural area does not include land covered by a greenhouse.
display_label: Exclusion of greenhouse land from agricultural area
subject: agricultural area
evidence_text: The reference in paragraph (1) to the agricultural area does not include a reference to any land which is covered by a greenhouse.
reason: Clarifies scope of agricultural area for derogation eligibility.

proposition_text: A derogation ceases to have effect unless the occupier sends to the Agency a written declaration that the derogation conditions in Schedule 3 will be met.
subject: derogation
object: occupier sends written declaration that Schedule 3 conditions will be met
evidence_text: A derogation granted under this regulation ceases to have effect unless the occupier to whom the derogation is granted has sent to the Agency a written declaration that the conditions set out in Schedule 3 ("the derogation conditions") will be met in relation to the holding.

proposition_text: The written declaration must be sent to the Agency within 28 calendar days of the derogation being granted.
subject: occupier
rule: must send written declaration to the Agency within
object: 28 calendar days of derogation being granted
temporal_condition: within 28 calendar days of the derogation being granted
evidence_text: The written declaration must be sent to the Agency within 28 calendar days of the derogation being granted.
reason: Specific time limit for compliance with declaration requirement.

proposition_text: The application must be submitted between 1st October and 31st December in the calendar year preceding that to which the application relates.
subject: occupier
object: 1st October and 31st December in the preceding calendar year
temporal_condition: between 1st October and 31st December in the calendar year preceding that to which the application relates
evidence_text: The application must be submitted between 1st October and 31stDecember in the calendar year preceding that to which the application relates.

proposition_text: An application relating to the calendar year commencing on 1st January 2017 may be submitted by 20th March 2017.
subject: occupier
conditions: application relates to calendar year commencing 1st January 2017
evidence_text: But an application relating to the calendar year commencing on 1st January 2017 may be submitted by 20th March 2017.

proposition_text: The application must be made in the form and manner published by the Secretary of State.
subject: occupier
object: form and manner published by the Secretary of State
evidence_text: The application must be made in the form and manner published by the Secretary of State.
